mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, username, email, phone, password_hash, nickname, status, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aisys_user (tenant_id, username, email, phone, password_hash, nickname, status) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{username}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'active'))
mapper.update: UPDATE aisys_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE aisys_user SET last_login_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE aisys_user SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.code FROM role r JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM permission p JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_role (user_id, role_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO user_role (user_id, role_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{rid}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
